# 1 Enoch Chapter 91 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Epistle of Enoch

---

**1** 'Methuselah, my son — call your brothers to me, gather all your mother's sons. The word is calling me, and the spirit has been poured over me. I must show you everything that will happen to you from now until the end.'

**2** So Methuselah went and gathered his brothers and all his relatives.

**3** Enoch addressed the whole family — the children of righteousness: 'Listen, sons of Enoch — hear every word your father speaks. I urge you, my beloved children: love what is right and live by it.

**4** Don't come to righteousness with divided loyalties. Don't keep company with people whose hearts go two ways. Walk in righteousness, my sons — it will guide you down good paths and be your constant companion.
